## Typeface is a Generative AI platform to supercharge personalized content for work

Typeface supercharges personalized content creation for workflows. Together, [Typeface and Microsoft](https://www.typeface.ai/partners/microsoft) accelerate your campaigns and team productivity. Harness personalized generative AI to create faster, easier, on-brand content across all channels, right within your existing Microsoft applications. Boost creative work powered by Azure AI, Stay in the flow of work within Microsoft Teams, and activate campaigns right within Microsoft Dynamics 365.

Accelerate personalized campaigns at scale across every team with GenAI - customized to each brand, audience, and marketing channel - to increase team productivity, time to market, and campaign success rates.

[Watch Product Demo](https://vimeo.com/906175547)

[Contact Us](https://www.typeface.ai/contact-sales)

What can Typeface do for me?

Images, social posts, blogs, ads, webpages, and more:

- Personalized shoppable content and landing pages for ecommerce and social

- Paid media campaigns on Google Ads

- Product descriptions & data enrichment

- Account-based campaigns (email & SMS)

- Campaign ideation and activation briefs

- Top-of-funnel content creation & reuse

- Employee communications and job postings

- Personalized, private, AI that is trained on your brand assets, audiences, and guidelines

- Multimodal: Customers can produce nearly all content types (images, copy, and more)

- Supercharge workflows with many easy-to-use templates across departments (marketing, product, sales, HR, & more)

- Secure with no data leakage to public models and content ownership
